notes:
- Account: Octant Financial Systems (large institutional fintech).
- Primary contact: CTO Marcus Engel; procurement lead: Priya Sharma.
- Business driver: move internal chat/agent and document search off managed public API to predictable Dedicated capacity for cost control and data residency.
- Key asks: guaranteed throughput during market open (9:30-16:00 ET), p99 latency SLO for chat flows, predictable reserved GPU sizing, clear fallback model routing when capacity constrained.
- POC summary: used a 13B open model with two quantization profiles (int8 and int4 variants). Observed tradeoff: int4 reduces GPU memory enabling 16k context but increases inference variance on rare tokens; int8 slightly higher cost but better tail latency stability.
- Model tuning requests from Octant: prefer 16k context for compliance logs, enable KV-cache prefixing for repeated user sessions, liberal batching for embeddings pipeline but tight batching + low-latency path for interactive chat.
- Cost sensitivity: high during trading hours (willing to pay premium for latency guarantees), moderate for background indexing/embeddings.
- Security: require SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs retained 3 years, EU data residency for European customers.
- Quote from Marcus: "We need a capacity contract we can bank on for market opens — no surprises."
- Action items: draft reserved GPU proposal (H100 x 12 with burst pool), SLA latency appendix, quantization & perf matrix for model variants, legal to review data residency clause.
- Stubs: pricing deck (drive link), SLA_v1 draft, POC perf spreadsheet (attached in Drive).
